section1.headline: Precision Surveys for Smarter Construction
section1.description: At Smartgrid Surveying, we provide expert building site surveying services designed to ensure accuracy, efficiency, and compliance in construction projects. Whether you're planning a residential, commercial, or industrial development, our advanced surveying technology and experienced professionals deliver the data you need to build with confidence.

section2.headline: Reliable. Accurate. Fast. Powerful.
section2.subtitle: Smartgrid Surveying is your trusted surveying partner!
section2.description: Build Smarter from the Ground Up—our drone-enabled site engineering surveys deliver precise measurements, rapid terrain insights, and informed decision-making for your construction projects. By capturing high-resolution topographic data, 3D ground models, and accurate boundary visuals, we streamline site planning and reduce costly rework. Whether you're breaking ground or managing infrastructure upgrades, SmartGrid Surveying gives you the geospatial clarity needed to engineer with confidence and precision.

siteEngineeringSurveys.headline: Precision Site Engineering Surveys
siteEngineeringSurveys.description: Explore how SmartGrid Surveying leverages cutting-edge drone, LiDAR, and geospatial technologies to deliver engineering-grade surveys that empower construction and infrastructure development.

items.title: Topographic Surveys
items.description: We map both natural and built features, offering vital elevation and terrain insights for civil and structural planning.

items.title: Construction Staking & Layout
items.description: Precision layout services ensure construction follows design specifications exactly—minimizing errors and delays.

items.title: 3D Laser Scanning & LiDAR Mapping
items.description: From point clouds to mesh models, we digitize your site for design coordination, BIM input, and pre-construction validation.

items.title: Boundary & Title Surveys
items.description: Establish legal property limits, easements, and encroachments—essential for permitting and land development.

items.title: As-Built Surveys
items.description: Document and verify completed works against original plans for certification, compliance, and project closeout.

items.title: Underground Utility Surveys
items.description: Detect and map buried infrastructure with minimal disruption—vital for excavation planning and utility coordination.

items.label: Pre-Survey Planning
items.description: Conduct a thorough site evaluation and assess flight parameters for drone survey readiness.

items.label: Establishing Ground Control
items.description: Place georeferenced ground control points (GCPs) for accurate integration of aerial data.

items.label: Drone Flight Operation
items.description: Deploy drone with precise flight paths, capturing high-resolution imagery and topographic data.

items.label: Data Processing & Analysis
items.description: Process aerial data using photogrammetry software to generate 3D models, orthoimages, and contours.

items.label: Validation & Accuracy Check
items.description: Use total stations and RTK-GNSS systems to validate drone data and ensure the highest accuracy.

items.label: Final Survey Deliverables
items.description: Generate CAD drawings, GIS layers, and digital reports for final project handover and analysis.

accuracyMatters.headline: Why Accuracy Matters
accuracyMatters.description: In land development, a 5–10 cm error can lead to boundary disputes, design misalignment, construction rework,and legal delays.
accuracyMatters.solution: At SmartGrid Surveying, we eliminate uncertainty by combining GNSS RTK positioning, robotic total stations,and UAV photogrammetry workflows.

items.title: Boundary Disputes
items.description: Millimeter drift on a boundary line can trigger a costly boundary dispute survey Kenya-wide — protecting titles, neighbors,and investments.

items.title: Design Misalignment
items.description: Models built on approximate ground data force field revisions that ripple through budgets — engineering survey precision keeps CAD,and BIM in true position.

items.title: Construction Rework
items.description: Wrong coordinates mean poured foundations, relocated services,and aborted works. Accurate control networks cut rework,and keep programs moving.

items.title: Legal Delays
items.description: Cadastral survey Nairobi approvals stall when plans don't match the ground. We deliver evidence-grade data that moves permits forward.

deliverables.headline: Deliverables You Receive
deliverables.description: Every engagement closes with a complete, engineer-ready data package — exported in open formats that feed straight into CAD, GIS,and construction management tools.

items.title: CAD Drawings
items.description: Layer-ready drawings for architects, engineers,and drafters — georeferenced to the project coordinate system.

items.title: PDF Survey Plans
items.description: Print-ready, scale-correct plans for approvals, permitting,and record keeping.

items.title: Contour Maps
items.description: Precision contours at 0.5 m or 1 m vertical intervals for grading, drainage,and earthworks design.

items.title: Orthomosaic Maps
items.description: Scale-correct aerial imagery mosaics that double as site basemaps for planning and monitoring.

items.title: Point Cloud Data
items.description: Millions of georeferenced points ready for volumetric analysis, BIM,and 3D modelling.

items.title: Coordinate Tables
items.description: Structured point lists — boundaries, pegs, control,and setting-out coordinates — readable by any field team.

items.title: GIS Layers
items.description: Query-ready spatial layers that drop straight into QGIS, ArcGIS, or any web map stack.

items.title: Survey Report
items.description: A professional, legally-compliant report documenting the methodology, accuracy,and results.

technology.headline: Surveying Technology We Use
technology.description: An integrated GNSS, total station, drone, LiDAR,and GPR toolkit — matched to each terrain, accuracy class,and deliverable.

items.title: FOIF A90 RTK GNSS System
items.description: Centimeter-level GNSS RTK positioning for boundary, control,and stakeout work in real time.

items.title: Robotic Total Stations
items.description: High-precision angle-and-distance measurement for tight urban sites,and engineering control.

items.title: UAV Mapping (DJI Matrice Series)
items.description: Enterprise drone platforms capturing high-resolution imagery for large-area mapping,and monitoring.

items.title: LiDAR & Photogrammetry Processing
items.description: Advanced point-cloud,and 3D modelling pipelines that turn raw captures into survey-grade products.

items.title: GPR Subsurface Utility Mapping
items.description: Non-destructive ground penetrating radar that sees buried utilities before the excavator arrives.
